feedback.answered: ReadIndex explicitly permits unnoticed loss and requires caller retry, so missing read completion by itself is not a grounded violation. The Ready interface requires Entries persisted before synchronous Messages, which is stricter than the README same-batch overlap wording; a future driver can obey both by persisting before send. Automatic joint exit is separately promised by the configuration API and is initiated by appliedTo; transfer rejection and retry ownership therefore merit their own question.
